name: hcapp_getMyKennelRunTotals
description: Returns the calling user's run and haring totals per kennel, with an optional filter to a single kennel. A synthetic GRAND TOTAL row (KennelId = null UUID) is appended as the first row (rowNum=0), containing the sum of all kennel totals. Totals are computed live from HC.HasherEventMap (not from denormalised count columns). Requires device auth via HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used by ValidateAppAuth to resolve the calling user.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated by ValidateAppAuth against the device secret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Optional kennel filter. NULL (or the legacy null-UUID '00000000-...') returns totals across all kennels. A valid kennel UUID filters to a single kennel. The null-UUID sentinel is normalised to NULL at the top of the SP for backward compatibility.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when ValidateAppAuth rejects the request (bad token, unknown device, etc.). errorType values follow the HC6 app error code scheme.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry logged by ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code within the errorType category.

rowsets.name: RunTotals
rowsets.description: Per-kennel run totals for the calling user, ordered by rowNum ascending. The GRAND TOTAL aggregate row is always first (rowNum=0) with KennelId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'. Per-kennel rows follow, ordered by totalRunsThisKennel DESC. Rows where totalRunsThisKennel=0 are excluded. Filtered events must have IsCountedRun=1 and IsVisible=1.

columns.name: KennelId
columns.description: The kennel's internal ID (HC.Kennel.id). '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelLogo
columns.description: Kennel logo URL (HC.Kennel.KennelLogo). '<no logo>' for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Full kennel name (HC.Kennel.KennelName). 'GRAND TOTAL ALL KENNELS' for the aggregate row.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: Count of HasherEventMap rows where AttendenceState >= 20, IsCountedRun=1, IsVisible=1 for this kennel. Summed across all kennels for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: totalPackRunsThisKennel
columns.description: totalRunsThisKennel minus totalHaringThisKennel (i.e. attended runs where the user was not a hare).

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: Count of HasherEventMap rows where IsHare != 0 within the counted runs. Summed across all kennels for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: following
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.Following value for the calling user at this kennel. 0 if no HasherKennelMap row exists (LEFT JOIN with COALESCE). Always 0 for the GRAND TOTAL row.

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel short name (HC.Kennel.KennelShortName). 'TOTALS' for the GRAND TOTAL row.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH around main query body
codeSmells.detail: ValidateAppAuth errors are caught and returned cleanly, but any SQL error in the CTE, temp table insert, or final SELECT (lines 70-123) will propagate as an unhandled exception with no standard error envelope. A TRY/CATCH wrapping the post-auth block should be added.

codeSmells.issue: GRAND TOTAL row mixed into result set via null-UUID sentinel
codeSmells.detail: Callers must detect KennelId='00000000-...' to identify the aggregate row. An explicit isGrandTotal BIT column would be cleaner and remove the need for callers to know the sentinel value.

codeSmells.issue: following column type mismatch vs table
codeSmells.detail: HasherKennelMap.Following is SMALLINT in the base table. The CTE exposes it as-is via COALESCE(hkm.Following, 0), so the result column is effectively SMALLINT. The HC5 contract documented it as INT — corrected in this HC6 contract.

breakingChanges: @kennelId default changed from the null-UUID sentinel ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') to NULL. The SP normalises the old sentinel to NULL for backward compatibility, so existing callers passing the null-UUID will continue to work.
Auth model changed from HC5 shared-secret pattern to HC6 ValidateAppAuth helper SP — callers must pass a token generated by the HC6 auth flow.
Error rowset column set changed: HC5 error rowsets included 'debugMessage'; HC6 error rowset (from ValidateAppAuth) does not expose debugMessage to callers — it is logged internally only.
